lines.text: “I paid. Here's my screenshot.” Real customers don't write paragraphs. They send a photo of their banking app, in Korean, in Japanese, at an angle.
Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, on Nebius Token Factory, reads the photo: the payment, not the balance, not the points, not the phone's clock.
Then the payment provider's ledger decides. Same amount, same minute: the payment is real. And the money chain shows where it got stuck.
Same screen, one number changed. The photo says forty-four thousand nine hundred. The ledger has never seen that payment. The ledger wins, and the reply politely asks for the statement line.
